scenarios.expectation: Two editable orders; explicit manual selection, agent extra change, Mini App edit, stale callback refusal and refreshed Telegram cards. Include original voice selection evidence and subsequent manual continuation.
Paid/proof edits are refused; current version, deadline, capacity and owner authority govern all entry points.
Crash after saved bound plan; resume unchanged command/key without another model invocation or duplicate mutation; current cards and subsequent manual continuation.
Crash after domain commit before outcome persistence; replay one mutation with unchanged command/key. Repeat with revoked rights and changed version.
Crash after outcome before Telegram completion; resume without replanning or duplicate mutation, showing current cards.

Actual test Zitadel verifies equivalent HTTP and typed admission: foreign/missing principal, inactive user before private intake, wrong issuer/audience/actor, revocation after discovery/binding, user denial of host-only operations and retryable provider outage.

Interrupted model/script work, registration replay/discovery and deletion races enforce current history/access authority before context, output or derived mutation. Durable terminal state preserves committed business effects.
Final saved state retains full authority/provenance, concurrent saves return one winner, invalid authority fails closed, and consumed voice cleanup does not trigger replanning.
Preserve enabled Mini App timetable/food/onboarding, bounded large results, native proof/upload/export, whole-batch inbox ordering and Python source identities in the final runtime.
